messages:
emma: Quick sync — VaultWave (Beth) asked for final checklist for marketplace + HSM BYOK pilot. Need owners for SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, KMS key policy, marketplace packaging, and press embargo. Who owns what?
omar: I can own KMS key policy and the HSM test harness.
beth (VaultWave): I can send certs tonight and the PKCS#11 details. We require connector version pinning and a 30d rotation window.
liam: I'll take SAML + SCIM mapping. Quick Q: nameID format — transient or persistent? Marketplace requires persistent.
andrea: I'll handle marketplace packaging and coordinate embargo with marketing/legal. Proposed embargo: 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. Legal cutoff?
emma: Legal wants a 48h review cutoff -> 2026-04-06 EOD. Also we need an e2e smoke test (10 steps). Omar/Liam — can you produce a short script?
omar: Yep, adding test harness + script to docs repo. Example smoke steps:
  1) rctl test connect --provider vaultwave --hsm-serial X123 --kms-policy test-policy.json
  2) rctl kms encrypt --key-id test-key --plaintext "hello"
  3) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://redwood.example/api/v1/secrets
I will include failure cases (HSM disconnect, expired cert).
liam: SCIM mapping sample I'll push: {"userName":"email","displayName":"name","active":"active"}. Note: group sync not in v1.
beth (VaultWave): We'll run a dry-run on our staging cloud on 2026-04-04 and hand results back same day. Pinging legal for embargo signoff.
integrations-bot: Reminder: create Jira epic REDWOOD-5284 (marketplace + VaultWave pilot) and link PRs.
andrea: I'll draft support runbook for HSM hardware errors -> escalation path to VaultWave ops + contact matrix.
emma: Great. Next check-in Fri 09:30 PT. If blockers pop up earlier, @beth please flag. :thumbsup:
